`guitar-mf-b3.wav` is a real classical-guitar recording (Raimundo 118,
performed by Brian Penkrot), University of Iowa Musical Instrument Samples,
created by Lawrence Fritts and recorded December 11, 2011.

Source:
https://theremin.music.uiowa.edu/sound%20files/MIS/Piano_Other/guitar/Guitar.mf.sulB.B3.mono.aif

Collection and usage terms: https://theremin.music.uiowa.edu/MIS.html
The university permits downloading and use in any project without restrictions.

Converted from 96 kHz, 24-bit mono AIFF to 96 kHz, 16-bit mono WAV. The first
eight seconds are retained, including the attack and decay. No tuning,
normalization or denoising was applied. Tests add deterministic broadband/colored
noise, 50 Hz hum and transients and vary the recording's level. The added noise
is modeled, not a recording of the user's room.
